Pemko 305 Standard Perimeter Gasketing

This is Pemko 305_N Standard Perimeter Gasketing. This perimeter gasketing is supplied with an EPDM ("N" insert - item number E2 (BL, GR). It is Air Infiltration Tested, BHMA Certified, Smoke Tested - UL1784Smoke Tested - UL1784, Fire Rated - UL10C - Positive PressureFire Rated - UL10C - Positive Pressure, and GREENGUARD Gold Certified.

Features and Specifications of the Pemko Standard Perimeter Gasketing:

  • Material: Anodized Aluminum
  • Color: Black EPDM insert
  • Rigid jamb weatherstrip is shown mounted on openings with 1/16" gaps; however, each weatherstrip can seal gaps up to the depth of its seal.
  • Smoke Tested - UL1784/li>
  • Fire Rated - UL10C - Positive PressureFire Rated - UL10C - Positive Pressure

Special ordred item. No Returns
